content: Deterministic replay in JS (DriftEngine, hayao, Balaur, caputchin): (1) fixed timestep only, time = tick count; (2) seeded PRNG with serializable/rewindable state — mulberry32 (32-bit int ops, bit-identical across engines) or sfc32/PCG32; never Math.random; (3) no wall-clock reads (Date.now/performance.now) inside the sim; (4) no direct input reads inside the sim — sample once per step and pass as data; (5) ordered iteration (arrays/insertion-ordered maps, never Set/object key order); (6) avoid platform libm transcendentals — use deterministic math or capMath-style swaps. Fingerprint world state per tick (hash) to verify replay. Snapshot/rollback is the deeper pattern if RL needs mid-episode resets.
